verdict.rationale: Clara documents a Card Configurations API that adds merchant-category, time, and day-of-week restrictions to cards, plus card lock/unlock. Category-based restriction is therefore a first-party capability. The docs do not show per-merchant rules, amount or spend limits, or explicit point-of-sale decline or auto-lock when spend falls outside policy. missing for 10: amount/spend-limit controls, individual merchant restrictions, documented automatic decline/auto-lock at point of sale, independent or hands-on corroboration.
